notes.subject: takhash
notes.rationale: תחש animal i stap wantaim nem tasol long Tanakh; olsemtaim i no klia wanem animal — dabel, seal, o narapela; mipela holim nem Hibru

notes.subject: skin bilong ol man sipsip
notes.rationale: אילם: ol tanim i no wankain — 'ram' (KJV) o 'man sipsip' (D4b); Tok Pisin tebol i makim man sipsip

notes.subject: i redpela
notes.rationale: מאדמים em i 'ol i redim olgeta' — pasin bilong painim kala, tupela i wankain tru

translation: Na ol skin bilong ol man sipsip i redpela, na ol skin bilong ol takhash, na ol diwai akasia;
